originalInput.name: Archive routines
originalInput.goal: Build the next year of preservation reminders; move weekend work forward.

tasks.description: Once a year, review the archive disaster recovery plan.
At quarterly intervals, test restoring files from backups.
At monthly intervals, inspect storage shelves for water damage.
At seven day intervals, check the climate data logger.
